We have identified the EAM potential file for Aluminum: `/potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy`. Now, let's create the LAMMPS input scripts for both the bulk and surface configurations.

### Bulk Configuration Input Script

```plaintext
# LAMMPS Input Script for Bulk Aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data aluminum.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

replicate 5 5 5

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step pe lx ly lz

run 0
```

### Surface Configuration Input Script

```plaintext
# LAMMPS Input Script for Surface Aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p f

read_data aluminum.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

replicate 5 5 5

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step pe lx ly lz

run 0
```
